answer: The horizon is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the beacon. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, unlocked only after continuous uptime, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. What survives to the comet is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
